title: The Girl Who Fell From the Sky

facts.claim: a 17-year-old fell about two miles and survived
she was in the jungle eleven days
Christmas Eve: the plane flew into a thunderstorm over the Peruvian Amazon; lightning struck; it broke up in the air
91 others died; she was the only survivor of 92
broken collarbone, eye injury, deep cuts
facts.note: source also lists a torn knee ligament and concussion

facts.claim: her parents were biologists; her father taught her to follow water downstream
facts.note: not on this page; needs a second source (her memoir or interviews)

facts.claim: she followed the water for ten days, ran out of food, had maggots in her wounds, passed bodies
facts.note: following a stream is confirmed; food, maggots and bodies need a second source

facts.claim: she found a boat and a hut on day ten; loggers found her the next day
facts.note: a hut used by hunters and woodcutters is confirmed; the day numbers and the boat need a second source

cast.desc: 17-year-old girl, fair hair, glasses lost in the fall
her father, field biologist, khaki shirt, binoculars
Juliane at about 14, shorts and boots
forest worker, straw hat, machete on belt

props.desc: a three-seat row torn from the cabin, her seat belt still fastened
a small paper bag of sweets, her only food
a small wooden boat with an outboard motor
glass specimen jar from her parents' field station
